name: Collins Scrabble Words
author: byo-pop
description: Adds Collins Scrabble Words, the international tournament list (about 280,000 words), to BookWorm's dictionary, with its definitions in Lex's balloon; a click on the balloon looks the word up online. The list comes from your own copy: make collins-words.txt (and collins-defs.txt) in this folder with games/bookworm/tools/make_collins_mod.py; without them the mod adds nothing. Games with it keep their own high scores.

words.note: A word from Collins Scrabble Words.

settings.label: Click on Lex's balloon
settings.help: A click on a word's definition opens the word in this online dictionary (in your browser).

settings.label: Lex names the list
settings.help: For a word only Collins has and no definition, Lex's balloon says it is a Collins word.
